notes.title: The Elevator: Beyond The Doors – Demo Now Live at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
We’re proud to present the demo of The Elevator: Beyond The Doors as part of Steam Next Fest!

This emotional, story-driven experience was crafted by a small, passionate team of 3 people over the course of just 3 months. Every scene, every line, every choice you make carries a piece of our hearts.

notes.title: One Life. Three Versions.
notes.content:
There was a time you were innocent.
Another when you were in love.
And perhaps a moment, long forgotten, where you were lost.
What if you could see them all?
The Elevator doesn’t ask you to pick just one.
It lets you walk through each memory.
Each version of yourself.
And each one will ask:
Was I ever truly happy? Or just pretending to be?

notes.title: Why This Story Was Written | Standing at the Door of an Elevator
notes.content:
When I started writing this story, I wasn't trying to create an adventure;
I was trying to create a confrontation.

I tried to capture the feelings that echo in the quiet moments of our lives —
the words we never said, the hugs we postponed, the things we left unsaid.

The Elevator isn't a journey outward.
It's a journey inward.
A quiet courage to face the memories, regrets, and fragile hopes locked behind closed doors.

Maybe this story was born from the yearning to find the things we once lost.
Maybe it was written with the hope that it's not too late to reach the places we thought we'd missed.

Soon, the elevator doors will open.
And maybe, the stories we've hidden inside us will find their way out too.

notes.title: Another Door Opens.
notes.content:
We've all had those moments we wish we could return to—a regret left unspoken, a goodbye we never wanted to say, a memory we can't quite let go of.

The Elevator is a journey through those echoes of the past.

Every floor opens onto a piece of the protagonist's life: a family conflict, a lost friendship, a moment of pure joy, or a glimpse into an imagined future.

This project is deeply personal for me. It's inspired by real moments—losses, missed chances, words I wish I had said.

If you're ready to step into the forgotten corridors of memory, The Elevator will be opening its doors soon on Steam.
